findings.resolution: Actual Mayo bipolar diagnosis/treatment supports lifetime history and treatment differentiation; Mayo suicide care362–377 plus causes/family/trauma supports disclosure during assessment; NHS depression Diet22–27 supports ordinary meals alongside NIMH. No nutritional suicide-prevention benefit inferred.
Important actionable and adverse-effect claims carry action/risk kinds with separately authored clinical support; informational assessment descriptions remain explanatory.

All14 sections read in both languages. Under25 equals24orunder;48h is NICE initial aftercare after self-harm with persistent safety concerns and never delays immediate help. DBT population qualification, postpartum emergency, local hotline scope and clinical medication follow-up are concordant.

resolution: Accepted current immutable candidate after independent clinical-source reading and claim/scope comparison. This is evidence/editorial review, not clinician approval or patient-specific advice.

category_decisions.rationale: Symptom entry covers passive wishes through plans, immediate danger, assessment, differential diagnoses, conditional care, medicine risks, ordinary nutrition, daily support, special populations, recovery and prevention across14 dimensions.
exclusions_considered: Underlying depression/bipolar/perinatal illness is not automatically diagnosed by ideation

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Crisis numbers are jurisdiction-specific. NICE48h post-self-harm aftercare is not a universal time allowance for thoughts or immediate danger. Adult ASQ clinical instrument is not a self-score or pediatric instrument; no universal drug or nutrition cure. Shared upstream literature disclosed.
